description: This header file defines the 'TensorWrapper' class, a wrapper around the Tensor class used within Facebook's PyTorch 'functorch' library to facilitate autograd and differentiable programming features. The file contains class declarations, constructor definitions, and utility functions related to Tensor wrapping and manipulation in the context of automatic differentiation.
external_methods: makeTensorWrapper(const Tensor& tensor, int64_t level, bool is_immutable=false)
makeTensorWrapper(const Tensor& tensor, const Interpreter& interpreter, bool is_immutable=false)

classes.name: TensorWrapper
classes.description: A subclass of c10::TensorImpl that wraps a Tensor to participate in autograd operations within functorch, holding additional metadata such as level and mutability flags, and managing its lifecycle status (alive/dead).

methods.name: TensorWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing a TensorWrapper with specified properties, including dispatch key set, underlying tensor, level, and mutability flags.

methods.name: refreshMetadata
methods.description: Method to refresh the internal metadata of the tensor wrapper, likely syncing state.

methods.name: const Tensor & value() const
methods.description: Returns the underlying tensor contained within the wrapper.

methods.name: std::optional<int64_t> level() const
methods.description: Returns the autograd level if the wrapper is alive.

methods.description: Checks if the tensor is immutable.

methods.name: is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the wrapper is currently active/alive.

methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor and detaches it from the autograd graph, with overloads for different versioning strategies.

methods.description: Copies metadata and state from another TensorImpl.

methods.description: Returns the type name of the tensor implementation.
